Privacy

Your details,
handled thoughtfully.

When you browse

This website does not include advertising trackers, analytics scripts, or embedded social-media feeds. Its photographs, fonts, styles, and scripts are served with the website. The hosting provider may process standard technical request information to deliver and secure the site.

When you inquire

The inquiry builder prepares text locally in your browser. It does not submit your details to a server or save them in browser storage. When you choose “Open in my email app,” your email app receives the draft. You decide whether to send it. Your email provider’s privacy practices apply.

Information you send

Information you email to Trevor is used to respond to your inquiry and discuss photography services. Only include details needed to plan your session. For questions about your information, contact trevoradair2@gmail.com.

Other websites

Links to Instagram and Facebook take you to those services. Their privacy practices apply when you visit them.
